scope: Final visible Draft; exact source/article/action/deployed bytes; core #638-#645 Mac-worker sequence; core #501/#307 telemetry path; core #626/#627/#634/#636/#637; HouseholdAgentKit #1, reviews and issues #2/#3/#11-#38; all-state same-source review searches; current review schema/discovery; and held-candidate custody. findings.title: Four pieces landed through two FleetRunner PRs
findings.location: Lines 6, 15-17 and 88 say four core/FleetRunner PRs merged and completed pieces 1-4; the section links only #638, #639 and #645.
findings.explanation: Core #639 merged piece 1. Piece-2 PR #643 and piece-3 PR #644 closed unmerged; their stacked changes arrived through merged piece-4 PR #645. Core #638 is the separate ADR-0110 merge. Thus three core PRs merged, only two of them FleetRunner delivery PRs, while four plan pieces landed.
findings.correction: Report three core merges: ADR #638 plus FleetRunner #639 and #645. Say four Mac-worker pieces landed through two FleetRunner PRs, with #643/#644 retained as closed review history.

findings.title: presenceMs default and bound are documented
findings.location: Line 70 says the default and configuration location are unknown and warns about configuring a value above 30 seconds.
findings.explanation: Core #645 states that presenceMs is a new optional worker setting with a 10-second default and 30-second maximum, documented in worker-release.md.
findings.correction: Report the 10-second default, enforced 30-second maximum and worker-setting surface; do not present an above-30-second value as an available misconfiguration.

findings.title: PR #1 does not gate every HouseholdAgentKit rung
findings.location: Lines 82 and 92 say no rung progression begins and none of issues #2-#10 can start until PR #1 merges.
findings.explanation: HouseholdAgentKit #1 is itself rungs 0 and 1. Issue #2 defines rung 2 without a founding-merge dependency. Issue #3 is the first cited rung that explicitly requires the independent review and founding PR merge.
findings.correction: Say PR #1 delivers rungs 0-1, rung 2 is a separate stage-host proof, and the explicit founding-merge prerequisite begins at rung 3 in the cited records.

findings.title: A telemetry investigation path already exists
findings.location: Line 96 and the third held candidate say the 0% streak has no investigation path and propose a new generic skill-telemetry audit.
findings.explanation: Merged core #501 records the telemetry defects, dedicated investigation, normative design, delivery handoff and verification notes under open fleet-runner umbrella #307. It says implementation still needs approved scope and a registered owner; that is a gate, not absence of a path.
findings.correction: Acknowledge the existing investigation and delivery path, separate the frozen legacy stream from current measurements, and name approved scope plus owner registration as the remaining gate instead of creating a duplicate audit.

findings.title: The Draft PRs already carry different statuses and gates
findings.location: Line 90 and the second held candidate describe #634/#626/#627 as undocumented and all five Draft PRs as lacking a documented status.
findings.explanation: The PR bodies distinguish a documentation-only pointer update (#634), reviewed context replacement (#636), active takeover implementation (#637), unresolved M3 HELD evidence and human gates (#627), and adoption-review intake (#626).
findings.correction: Preserve each PR's existing status, evidence and gates. Ask only for unresolved prioritization decisions after summarizing those records; do not describe the whole set as undocumented or ownerless.

findings.title: The broad hardening candidate is held and duplicative
findings.location: Lines 103-107 propose /hardening HouseholdAgentKit#1 as the highest-leverage action.
findings.explanation: The dated action map records review pending because HouseholdAgentKit#1 is an unsupported qualified candidate reference, with both reviewer roles not verified. Issues #11-#38 already carry individual contracts, checks, budgets and owner steps.
findings.correction: Keep the candidate held and non-dispatchable; work through the existing issue contracts and owner priorities or create a source-qualified replacement only after supervised review.

findings.title: Issue #21 is not established as the PR #1 merge gate
findings.location: Line 82 calls HouseholdAgentKit #21 the current merge-path gate for PR #1.
findings.explanation: Issue #21 is a P0 owner decision about the engine's November 25 calendar gate and is due November 23. PR #1 defines rungs 0-1 but does not identify #21 as its merge prerequisite in the public record checked.
findings.correction: Describe #21 as an open P0 owner decision affecting the later engine calendar; call it a PR #1 blocker only when an owner decision or PR dependency records that gate.

findings.title: Shared transport does not authenticate reviewer independence
findings.location: Lines 11, 38 and 82 rely on the independent review as a quality signal.
findings.explanation: Review 6002962131 reports OpenAI Codex; review 6003036606 reports a complementary Claude Code session and says it is not the independent review. Both were submitted through the same ojfbot account, which authenticates transport but not a separate human, provider or session identity.
findings.correction: Attribute the reports to their stated agents while keeping the shared GitHub login separate; do not treat that login or model agreement as independent human/provider authentication.
